description: Policy Engine (app/services/policy) inputs. Every field here is a real PolicyInput field from app/schemas/policy_decision.py; the decision itself is produced only by the real PolicyDecisionEngine against the six shipped rules in app/services/policy/rules.py. The dataset states what each rule's gates require so a run is auditable against the code - it does not contain any decision.

shipped_rules.POLICY-BLOCK-IP-001: block_ip, min risk LOW, confidence >= 0.50, evidence required, allowed; approval above HIGH
shipped_rules.POLICY-BLOCK-DOMAIN-001: block_domain, min risk LOW, confidence >= 0.60, evidence required, allowed; approval above HIGH
shipped_rules.POLICY-QUARANTINE-FILE-001: quarantine_file, min risk MEDIUM, confidence >= 0.70, evidence required, always requires approval
shipped_rules.POLICY-DISABLE-ACCOUNT-001: disable_account, min risk MEDIUM, confidence >= 0.70, evidence required, always requires approval
shipped_rules.POLICY-TERMINATE-SESSION-001: terminate_session, min risk LOW, confidence >= 0.60, evidence required, allowed; approval above HIGH
shipped_rules.POLICY-ISOLATE-ENDPOINT-001: isolate_endpoint, min risk HIGH, confidence >= 0.70, evidence + investigation + supported attribution required, always requires approval

fail_closed: An action with no applicable rule yields the engine's no-coverage decision rather than an allow.

scenarios.purpose: block_ip at MEDIUM risk with confidence above the 0.50 floor and evidence present. The rule's approval_above_risk_level=HIGH gate is inclusive, so only a risk level below HIGH is allowed outright.
block_ip at HIGH risk. The rule's approval_above_risk_level=HIGH gate is inclusive ('at or above'), so the engine escalates to a human instead of allowing the block.
block_ip with the evidence requirement unmet. The engine denies rather than proceeding on an unsupported request.
quarantine_file at MEDIUM risk with confidence above the 0.70 floor. The rule sets requires_approval unconditionally, so even a satisfied gate routes to a human.

isolate_endpoint is the high-impact rule: HIGH risk, confidence >= 0.70, investigation available and a supported attribution status. The gates pass, but the rule still requires approval, so this scenario is the legitimate route into the HITL and SOAR commands.
The same action with attribution_status=null. The require_attribution gate cannot be satisfied, so the engine denies the containment request outright.
isolate_endpoint below the rule's HIGH risk floor, showing the minimum_risk_level gate rejecting an under-scored containment request.
quarantine_file at HIGH risk with full confidence. The rule sets requires_approval unconditionally, so the satisfied gate still routes to a human.
quarantine_file at HIGH risk with confidence exactly on the 0.70 floor. The floor is inclusive, and the unconditional requires_approval rule still escalates.
isolate_endpoint at HIGH risk with investigation evidence present. The rule's inclusive approval_above_risk_level=HIGH gate escalates the containment to a human.

not_invented: no decision, policy_decision_id, reason or requires_approval value is stored here
the approval-pending state is produced only by the HITL service, never asserted by this file
